verdict.rationale: Intuit Intelligence chat is documented to 'help resolve anomalies' and QBO ships discrepancy/reconciliation reports (Reconciliation Discrepancy Report, Missing Checks Report) that could surface duplicate or anomalous transactions, and the official MCP server exposes 145 QBO API tools that an AI-native user could wire an agent to for ledger monitoring. However there is no first-party feature explicitly described as an autonomous agent that continuously monitors the ledger and proactively flags duplicate transactions or spend anomalies before close — this requires assembling capabilities via MCP/chat rather than a purpose-built close-audit agent. Missing for 10: dedicated pre-close anomaly/duplicate-detection agent workflow, evidence of automated flagging without manual chat queries, and independent/hands-on validation of anomaly detection accuracy.
